title: DataQualityDimension
description: A Data Quality Dimension classifies what a test is checking, such as Completeness or Accuracy. Test definitions and test cases reference a dimension by relationship, so renaming or recolouring one updates it everywhere. OpenMetadata ships a set of system dimensions that cannot be edited or deleted; users with the right permission can create their own on top of them.

id.description: Unique identifier of this data quality dimension instance.

name.description: Name that identifies this data quality dimension.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this data quality dimension.

fullyQualifiedName.description: FullyQualifiedName of the data quality dimension, same as the name.

description.description: Description of what this dimension measures and when to use it.

style.description: UI style, holding the colour the dimension is rendered with.

provider.description: System dimensions ship with OpenMetadata and can neither be edited nor deleted. User dimensions are fully editable.

owners.description: Owners of this data quality dimension.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.
